answer: Embodied Latency Attestation. Each identity must continuously answer timing challenges routed through a fixed physical knoll of relay hardware; response delays are measured against known signal propagation, so a single operator cannot fake distance for many agents at once. To reach the summit of trust, an identity must sustain months of clean timing records. A Sybil farm pays real hardware and bandwidth per identity, and the haven of shared clocks collapses under challenge diversity.
